 The Verge The Verge logo. Notifications Notifications GTA VI: all the news on Rockstar’s next entry in the Grand Theft Auto series 
 See all Stories
 Posted Nov 9, 2026 at 10:32 PM UTC J Jay Peters Take-Two’s CEO: “Rockstar has completed the development of GTA VI.” The game, set to launch on November 19th, was delayed twice . Based on that line from CEO Strauss Zelnick, which he said on today’s Q2 fiscal year 2027 earnings call, seems like that’s not happening again. Pre-orders for the game are tracking “far above” initial expectations .
 Zelnick closed the call by saying that “I know you all are going to have a great time playing GTA VI while you’re at home for the holidays.”
